explanation: A group of beings mentioned in Genesis 6, whose origin and nature are debated; some believe they were giants or angels.
The term used to describe divine beings, possibly angels, who according to Genesis 6 had children with the daughters of men.
Women born of human parents who became involved in relationships with the sons of God, resulting in the Nephilim.
The main character in the flood story, a righteous man chosen by God to survive the great flood and save his family and the animals on earth.
A large ship built by Noah according to God's instructions to protect him, his family, and the animals from the flood.
A great deluge sent by God to destroy all living creatures on earth, except for Noah, his family, and the animals on the ark.
A moral principle that involves acting in accordance with God's will and commands, something for which Noah is praised in Genesis 6.
